VBO:0200348.summary: Easygoing and playful in her owner’s account, one-year-old Chinese Crestepoo Coco offers a personal glimpse of this Chinese Crested–Poodle cross. Her keeper describes a quick learner who already knew basic commands and about a dozen tricks. Another one-year-old dog, Suki, is described as happy and playful.
VBO:0200348.shortDescription: A Chinese Crested–Poodle cross; Coco’s keeper describes an easygoing, playful dog who learned commands and many tricks.
